knowledge_abstraction.general_principle: Operations writing into user-provided tensors may cause unsafe behavior when tensor metadata and underlying storage capacity are inconsistent.

risk_dimensions.shape: Mismatch between expected output shape and provided output tensor should be explored.
risk_dimensions.dtype: Different dtype storage requirements may affect boundary behavior.
risk_dimensions.memory: Shared storage, views, and insufficient storage capacity are important risks.
risk_dimensions.device: Backend-specific output handling should be considered.
risk_dimensions.execution_state: Operations with user-controlled output tensors introduce additional states.

failure_mechanism.description: Tensor metadata manipulation may not correctly match underlying storage capacity, causing unsafe memory access.

input_exploration: Explore mismatched metadata and storage conditions.
constraint_awareness: Consider output tensor ownership and storage boundaries.
oracle_strategy: Check sentinel values around tensor storage.

important_considerations: Output tensor constraints may expose memory safety issues.
llm_reasoning_guidance.generation_strategy: Generate various output tensor constraint violations instead of reproducing one storage bug.
